what: Etsy seller based in Jordan reports their shop of 5,900+ orders over eight years will be forcibly closed on August 5, 2025, because Etsy removed PayPal as a payment option and Etsy Payments is unavailable in Jordan.
verbatim_snippet: "Since 2017, I have run a small Etsy shop from Jordan, completing over 5,900 orders and fully complying with Etsy's rules. I was notified that (my Etsy shop will be forcibly closed on 5 August 2025), due to Etsy's decision to remove PayPal as a payment option and the absence of Etsy Payments in Jordan - leaving me no means to receive payments."
notes: Trustpilot page verified via Google search index. Jordan-based seller. 8+ years on platform (since 2017). 5,900+ completed orders. Forced closure due to PayPal removal and no Etsy Payments availability in Jordan. Seller states they proposed "multiple solutions" to Etsy.
